judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The quest shape (secret tunnel behind the barrels, an offhand death of the brother, a gift and a hand-off to the next quest-giver) and the plain journal line are Nox-like. But the barks give it away: 'Ew!', the confused 'You're thinking of my brother, sorry.' and the overworked 'Hmm... I admit... But' read like modern pastiche rather than Westwood's terse town chatter.
